notes: Route 1 ends at «مولى ابن أبي أحمد»; the text runs «أحمدقال» together, and the Companion of the saying is written only in the variant

Group 2 («وقال لنا القعنبي ... عن أبي سفيان واسمه قزمان») is Abu Dawud's variant remark naming a different transmitter. «أبي سفيان» and «قزمان» are one man («واسمه» is a gloss), so the surface is the name alone
